nodes.text: Use the manual installer only if you want finer-grained control, want to avoid the plugin path entirely, or your Claude Code build has trouble resolving the self-hosted marketplace entry.

nodes.text: Do not stack install methods. The most common broken setup is: /plugin install first, then install.sh --profile full or npx ecc-install --profile full afterward.
